slide1.title: One job, one route
slide1.body: A buyer books several farmers at once. You get it as a single job with the pickups already in the best order, and the drop at the end.

slide2.title: Scan at the drop, money moves
slide2.body: At each depot you scan the buyer's code. That confirms the delivery, releases the farmers' payment, and books your trip fee. No paperwork.

slide3.title: Weak signal is fine
slide3.body: Your route, pickups and scans are saved on the phone. They sync on their own when you pass through network.

phone.title: Your mobile number
phone.note: We send a 6-digit code by SMS. Buyers and farmers see this number on the day of a pickup.
phone.numberLabel: Your mobile number, without the country code
phone.numberError: Enter a Sri Lankan mobile number, like 77 123 4567
phone.oneAccount: One number, one account. If the phone is shared at home, use your own number.

done.title: Sent for checking

step1.title: Your vehicle
step1.heading: What do you drive?
step1.note: Farmers see this before they hand over their produce.
step1.help: Pick the vehicle you collect produce with. You can change it later from your profile.

step2.title: Plate and load
step2.help: The plate number is checked before you are verified. The load is how much you can carry in one trip.

step3.title: Where you work
step3.heading: Which district?
step3.help: Pick the district you usually collect produce in. Jobs there are shown to you first.
